title: 第22章临江较技铁寻柳扬威第23章花楼卧底暗窥朝秘

暮秋江水，寒浪翻涌。
西风卷着江面上的水雾，横掠过临江渡口的乱石滩，将岸边枯黄的芦苇吹得簌簌乱响。浊浪拍打着嶙峋青石，溅起细碎的水花，落在滩头的泥地上，转瞬便被秋风吹干，只留一片湿冷的痕迹。天色沉郁，铅灰色的云絮低低压在江面，将落日余晖尽数掩去，整段江水都透着一股肃杀沉寂的气息。
滩头立着两道身影，一静一动，风骨凛然。
左侧男子一身玄色短打，劲装束身，腰束玄铁窄带，肩背宽阔，身姿挺拔如松。他便是铁寻，掌中一柄漆黑铁剑静静垂落地面，剑刃未出鞘，却自有一股沉凝霸道的气势，周身气息沉稳内敛，仿佛与脚下青石融为一体，不动则已，一动便有雷霆之势。他面无表情，双眸锐利如鹰，目光死死锁住上游江面的来路，指节微微收紧，握剑的掌心已然蓄满劲力，周身气流凝滞，只待敌至。
身侧而立的柳扬，则是一身素白长衫，衣袂被江风拂得微微翻飞，看似温润儒雅，毫无锋芒，实则腰背挺直，步履沉稳。他腰间悬着一柄细骨软剑，剑鞘素白无纹，低调朴素，可熟悉他的人皆知，这柄软剑柔中藏刚，虚实难测，是江湖中最难招架的奇门兵器。柳扬眉目清俊，神色淡然，不见半分慌乱，唯有眼底深处藏着一丝冷冽锋芒，抬手轻轻拂去肩头风尘，动作从容不迫，仿佛全然未将即将到来的危机放在眼中。
“来了。”
铁寻低声开口，嗓音低沉沙哑，带着久经江湖的沉稳。他没有转头，目光始终锁定江面，空气中已然传来细微的破空之声，混杂着船桨击水的声响，穿透呼啸江风，清晰落入二人耳中。
柳扬微微颔首，轻声应道：“来得倒快，看来这批人，是铁了心要截下我们。”
二人并非偶然驻足此处。一日前，他们夜闯黑风寨，破了寨中盘踞多年的恶势力，取回被劫掠的赈灾银两，断了朝中奸臣与江湖恶徒勾结的线索。此事彻底触怒了幕后之人，朝中暗卫与江湖杀手联手，一路追剿，不眠不休，从山道追到江畔，紧追不舍，硬生生将二人逼至这临江绝境。
身后是滔滔大江，无舟可渡，前路被追兵封锁，乱石滩地势开阔，无山林遮蔽，无巷道隐匿，竟是一处实打实的死地。可铁寻与柳扬并肩而立，神色坦荡，不见半分怯意。江湖行走多年，生死对峙早已是寻常，越是绝境，二人心中的战意越是滚烫。
不多时，江面尽头浮现数艘快船，船身漆黑，船桨翻飞，破水而来，速度极快，带起一道道雪白水痕。船身无任何标识，可船上之人个个身着深色劲装，蒙面裹巾，腰间佩刀，气息凶悍肃杀，动作整齐划一，绝非普通江湖草莽。为首一艘快船船头，立着一名披氅壮汉，身形魁梧，肩宽体壮，双手负于身后，眼神阴鸷锐利，远远便锁定滩头二人，周身杀气凛冽，扑面而来。
五艘快船次第靠岸，重重撞在滩边青石上，发出沉闷巨响。数十名蒙面杀手纵身跃下船舱，落地无声，步法轻盈却沉稳，显然都是久经厮杀的精锐死士。众人迅速列阵，层层合围，瞬间便将铁寻、柳扬二人困在乱石滩中央，包围圈密不透风，不留半分退路。
为首壮汉缓步走出，脚下青石被他踏得微微震颤，每一步都带着厚重压迫之感。他抬手扯去面上黑巾，露出一张棱角粗犷、布满刀疤的面庞，眉眼间戾气纵横，眼神冰冷刺骨。
“铁寻、柳扬。”壮汉声如洪钟，带着十足的戾气，“我奉上官之命，缉拿你二人归案。束手就擒，尚可留全尸，若是顽抗，今日便让你们葬身这临江浊浪之中，尸骨无存！”
此人正是此次追兵统领，江湖人称“裂山刀”的厉奎，一身外门硬功炉火纯青，掌中厚背***重达数十斤，刀法霸道凶悍，大开大合，蛮力惊人，死在他刀下的江湖高手不计其数。此次奉命追剿，他一路紧追不舍，誓要将二人斩杀于江畔，了结此事。
铁寻抬眼，目光冷冽扫过厉奎，淡淡开口：“黑风寨作恶多端，劫掠赈灾银两，残害百姓，本就罪该万死。你等甘愿为奸人爪牙，助纣为虐，也配谈缉拿归案？”
柳扬紧随其后，声音温润却带着凛然正气：“庙堂污秽，江湖乱象，尔等不分善恶，滥杀侠义之士，今日临江此地，便是你们的葬身之地。”
二人语气平静，却字字铿锵，透着无惧生死的坦荡。
厉奎闻言，骤然狂笑出声，笑声粗狂暴戾，裹挟着浓烈杀气，在江畔回荡：“好一个伶牙俐齿！既然你们执意找死，那本统领便成全你们！听闻你们二人一刚一柔、一硬一虚，联手纵横江湖鲜有敌手，今日我便要看看，你们究竟有几分真本事！”

话音未落，厉奎猛地抬手一挥，厉声喝道：“列阵！杀！”
一声令下，周遭数十名蒙面杀手同时动了。众人身形疾掠，刀光骤然亮起，冰冷的刀锋映着阴沉天色，泛着森森寒芒。劲风四起，刀气纵横，无数刀影交织成片，密密麻麻朝着滩头二人笼罩而下，攻势迅猛凌厉，毫无拖沓，尽显死士悍不畏死的凶悍本性。
面对漫天刀网，铁寻神色未变，周身气场骤然沉凝。他手腕微抖，沉腰立马，握住剑柄的手掌骤然发力。
“铮——”
一声清越剑鸣划破江风，漆黑铁剑应声出鞘，剑身乌光流转，不见璀璨锋芒，却透着厚重磅礴的力量，剑气沉凝内敛，压得周遭气流骤然凝滞。
铁寻武学走至刚至阳之路，剑法沉稳霸道，招招厚重有力，攻守兼备，无半分花哨，每一剑都蕴含千钧之力。只见他身形稳立如磐石，铁剑横扫而出，剑光厚重如墨，带着破空锐响，直面迎面袭来的数柄钢刀。
“铛！铛！铛！”
连续数声金铁交鸣巨响震彻江畔，刺耳震耳。几名率先冲上前的杀手只觉一股雄浑无匹的巨力顺着刀锋反震而来，手臂瞬间发麻，虎口崩裂渗血，手中钢刀再也握不住，脱手翻飞而出。几人来不及反应，便被铁剑带出的凌厉剑气扫中胸口，身形骤然倒飞出去，重重砸在乱石滩上，挣扎数下便没了声息。
一剑之威，竟强横至此。
另一边，柳扬已然出手。他身形轻晃，素白长衫随风翻飞，身姿飘逸灵动，宛如闲云流水，全然没有硬拼的凶悍，却处处封住敌手攻势。他腰间细骨软剑倏然出鞘，剑身纤细柔韧，银光闪闪，看似柔弱无骨，舞动起来却虚实变幻，难以捉摸。
柳扬精通柔剑之道，讲究以柔克刚、以虚破实，身法轻盈迅捷，游走于刀光剑影之间，身形飘忽不定，屡屡在间不容发之际避开致命攻势。对手刀势凶悍，直劈直砍，他便侧身旋步，软剑缠绕而出，精准缠住对方刀身，手腕轻轻一转，借力打力，瞬间卸去对方磅礴劲力。
原本凶悍刚猛的刀势，遇上柳扬的柔剑，如同重拳砸入棉絮，无处发力，尽数落空。不少杀手招式用老，劲力尽泄，身形失衡，柳扬软剑顺势轻点，剑光一闪，精准划过敌手咽喉、手腕要害，招式精准狠辣，一击制敌，从无多余动作。
二人一左一右，并肩作战，配合默契无间，早已历经无数生死战局，无需言语沟通，便知彼此攻守节奏。
铁寻正面硬撼，沉稳守御，厚重铁剑挡下所有正面强攻，稳稳稳住阵脚，将敌手凶悍攻势尽数拦截；柳扬游走侧翼，灵动突袭，凭借绝妙身法与柔剑招式，拆解破绽，收割战局。一刚一柔，一守一攻，一稳一灵，两道剑光一黑一白，在乱石滩上交织纵横，攻守兼备，浑然一体。
数十名杀手轮番冲杀，攻势连绵不绝，层层叠叠，可始终无法突破二人联手防线。但凡逼近身前之人，要么被铁寻重剑震飞重创，要么被柳扬柔剑封喉制敌，滩头很快便倒下一片尸体，鲜血浸染青石，顺着石缝流淌，汇入滩边浅水，将清冷江水染得暗红。
厉奎立在包围圈外，冷眼旁观，面色愈发阴沉难看。他原本以为，数十名精锐死士合围，对付区区两人，定然转瞬便可拿下，不费吹灰之力。可此刻战局反转，手下杀手轮番冲锋，死伤惨重，却始终无法撼动二人分毫，甚至被二人联手压得节节败退，攻势愈发孱弱。
“一群废物！”厉奎低声怒骂，眼底戾气暴涨。他深知手下死士的战力，个个都是以一敌十的精锐，今日却被两人死死压制，足以见得铁寻、柳扬联手战力之恐怖，远超传闻。
再拖下去，手下死士必将尽数折损于此，届时只剩自己一人对敌，局势将彻底被动。厉奎不再观望，脚步猛地一踏地面，身形骤然窜出，快如奔雷，裹挟一身凶悍杀气，直扑战圈中央。
“退下！”厉奎厉声大喝。
残存的杀手闻言，立刻齐齐后撤，退出战圈，远远围立在外围，喘息调息，不敢再贸然上前。

瞬间清空战场，乱石滩中央只剩铁寻、柳扬与厉奎三人对峙，空气瞬间凝滞，肃杀气氛攀升至顶点。江风呼啸，卷着血腥气扑面而来，浪花拍岸的声响愈发清晰，却衬得此刻对峙愈发沉寂凶险。

In late autumn, the river is surging with cold waves.
The west wind swept the water mist on the river, swept across the rocky beach at the ferry crossing, and made the withered yellow reeds on the shore rustle. The turbid waves beat against the rugged bluestones, splashing into tiny splashes of water that landed on the muddy ground at the beach. They were blown dry by the autumn wind in an instant, leaving only a wet and cold trace. The sky was gloomy, and lead-gray clouds hung low on the river, covering up all the afterglow of the setting sun. The entire stretch of the river exuded an aura of chilling silence.
There are two figures standing on the beach, one is silent and the other is moving, with an awe-inspiring appearance.
The man on the left is dressed in a short black suit, with a strong attire and a narrow black iron belt around his waist. His shoulders are broad and his posture is as tall as a pine tree. He is Tie Xun, with a dark iron sword in his hand hanging quietly to the ground. The blade is not unsheathed, but it has a calm and domineering aura. The aura around him is calm and restrained, as if it is integrated with the bluestone under his feet. If he doesn't move, it will be like thunder. His face was expressionless, his eyes were as sharp as an eagle, his eyes were fixed on the path upstream of the river, his knuckles were slightly tightened, the palm holding the sword was already full of strength, and the airflow around his body was stagnant, just waiting for the enemy to arrive.
Liu Yang, who stood beside him, was wearing a plain white gown, and his clothes were fluttering slightly in the river breeze. He looked gentle and elegant, without any edge, but in fact his back was straight and his steps were steady. There is a soft sword hanging from his waist. The scabbard is white and has no lines. It is low-key and simple. But everyone who is familiar with him knows that this soft sword has strength hidden in its softness. Its true and false are unpredictable. It is the most difficult weapon in the world to parry. Liu Yang had a handsome face and a calm expression. There was no trace of panic. There was only a cold edge hidden deep in his eyes. He raised his hand to gently brush away the dust on his shoulders. His movements were calm and unhurried, as if he did not pay attention to the upcoming crisis at all.
"Coming."
Tie Xun spoke in a low voice, his voice low and hoarse, with a calmness that had been in the world for a long time. He did not turn his head and kept his gaze fixed on the river. There was already a subtle sound of breaking through the air, mixed with the sound of the oars hitting the water, penetrating the roaring river wind and falling clearly into the ears of the two of them.
Liu Yang nodded slightly and responded softly: "We arrived too soon. It seems that these people are determined to intercept us."
The two of them didn't stop here by chance. One day ago, they broke into Heifeng Village at night, defeated the evil forces that had been entrenched in the village for many years, retrieved the plundered disaster relief silver, and cut off the clues of the collusion between the treacherous officials in the court and the villains. This incident completely angered the people behind the scenes. The secret guards of the DPRK and the Jianghu killers joined forces to pursue them all the way, sleeplessly, from the mountain road to the river bank. They pursued them closely, forcing the two of them to this desperate situation near the river.
Behind him was a raging river with no boats to cross, and the road ahead was blocked by pursuers. The rocky beach was open, with no mountains and forests to cover it, and no alleyways to hide it. It turned out to be a real place of death. But Tie Xun and Liu Yang stood side by side, with magnanimous expressions and no trace of timidity. After traveling in the world for many years, life and death confrontations have long been common. The more desperate the situation, the hotter the fighting spirit in their hearts.
Not long after, several fast boats appeared at the end of the river. Their hulls were dark, their oars were flying, and they broke through the water at extremely fast speeds, leaving streaks of snow-white water behind them. There are no signs on the boat, but the people on the boat are all wearing dark clothes, covering their faces with scarves, and carrying knives at their waists. Their auras are fierce and murderous, and their movements are uniform. They are definitely not ordinary rivers and lakes. Standing on the bow of the first clipper boat was a strong man in a cloak. He was tall, with broad shoulders and a strong body. His hands were behind his back. His eyes were sharp and sinister. He locked eyes with the two people on the beach from a distance. He was filled with murderous aura and came towards them.
The five clippers docked one after another and hit the bluestone on the beach hard, making a dull and loud noise. Dozens of masked killers jumped out of the cabin and landed silently. Their steps were light but steady. They were obviously elite soldiers who had been fighting for a long time. Everyone quickly formed an array and surrounded them layer by layer, instantly trapping Tie Xun and Liu Yang in the middle of the rocky beach. The encirclement was airtight, leaving no escape route.
The strong man walked out slowly, the bluestone beneath his feet trembling slightly as he stepped on it, and every step felt heavy and oppressive. He raised his hand and wiped away the black faceHe wore a scarf, revealing a face with rough edges and scars, a fierce look between his brows and eyes, and cold and piercing eyes.
"Tie Xun, Liu Yang." The strong man's voice was like a bell, full of venom, "I have been ordered by the superior officer to arrest you two and bring them to justice. If you are captured without mercy, you can still keep your whole body. If you resist, you will be buried in the turbulent waves near the river today, and no bones will be left!"
This person was the leader of the pursuit, Li Kui, known as the "Splitting Mountain Sword" in the world. He was a proficient in external martial arts, with a thick-backed weapon in his palm weighing dozens of kilograms. His sword skills were domineering and fierce, with wide opening and closing, and astonishing brute force. Countless masters in the world died under his sword. This time he was ordered to pursue and suppress them, and he pursued them all the way, vowing to kill the two of them by the river and end the matter.
Tie Xun raised his eyes, glanced at Li Kui coldly, and said calmly: "Heifeng Village has done many evil things, plundering disaster relief money, and harming the people. You deserve death. You are willing to be a traitor's pawn and help the evildoers, and you are worthy of being arrested and brought to justice?"
Liu Yang followed closely behind, his voice gentle but with awe-inspiring righteousness: "The temples are filthy, the rivers and lakes are chaotic, you do not distinguish between good and evil, and kill chivalrous people indiscriminately. This place near the river today will be your burial place."
The two spoke calmly, but each word was sonorous, revealing a magnanimity without fear of life or death.
When Li Kui heard the words, he suddenly laughed wildly. The laughter was rough and violent, and it was wrapped with strong murderous intent. It echoed along the riverside: "What a sharp-tongued person! Since you insist on seeking death, I will help you! I heard that you two are one strong, one soft, one hard and one weak. There are few rivals in the world when you join forces. Today I want to see how much real ability you have!"
Before he finished speaking, Li Kui raised his hand and shouted sternly: "Array! Kill!"
With an order, dozens of masked killers around him moved at the same time. The bodies of the people flew by quickly, and the sword light suddenly lit up. The cold blade reflected the gloomy sky, glowing with a cold light. Strong winds were blowing, the sword energy was everywhere, and countless sword shadows intertwined into a sheet, densely covering the two people on the beach. The attack was fast and fierce, without any delay, fully demonstrating the fierce nature of a dead soldier who is not afraid of death.
Facing the sky full of sword nets, Tie Xun's expression did not change, and his aura suddenly condensed. His wrist trembled slightly, his waist sank and he stood up, and the palm holding the sword hilt suddenly exerted force.
"Zheng——"
A clear sword cry cut through the river wind, and the jet-black iron sword was unsheathed. The sword body was filled with black light. There was no bright edge, but it revealed heavy and majestic power. The sword energy was calm and restrained, causing the surrounding airflow to suddenly freeze.
Tie Xun's martial arts is on the road of Gangzhiyang. His swordsmanship is calm and domineering, his moves are thick and powerful, both offensive and defensive, without any flashiness, and every sword contains a huge amount of power. He was standing as steady as a rock, and the iron sword swept out. The sword light was as thick as ink, with a sharp sound that broke through the air, and he faced several steel knives that were coming towards him.
"Dang! Dang! Dang!"
Several loud sounds of gold and iron mingling in succession shook the river bank, ear-piercing and ear-piercing. The few killers who were the first to rush forward felt an unparalleled force coming back from the blade. Their arms were instantly numb, and the tiger's mouth cracked and oozed blood. They could no longer hold the steel knife in their hands and flew out. The few people had no time to react before they were struck in the chest by the sharp sword energy brought out by the iron sword. Their bodies suddenly flew out and hit the rocky beach hard. After struggling for a few times, they became silent.
The power of a sword is so powerful.
On the other side, Liu Yang had already taken action. His figure was swaying lightly, his plain white gown fluttering in the wind, his posture elegant and agile, like flowing clouds and flowing water. He was not fierce at all, but he blocked the opponent's offensive at every turn. The thin and soft sword on his waist suddenly came out of its sheath. The sword was slender and flexible, with shining silver light. It seemed weak and boneless, but when it danced, it changed reality and reality, making it elusive.
Liu Yang is proficient in the art of the soft sword, emphasizing the use of softness to overcome hardness and the use of virtuality to break the solid. His body is light and quick, and he can move between the light and shadow of the sword. His body shape is erratic, and he often avoids fatal attacks when there is no opportunity to strike. The opponent's sword was fierce, slashing straight at him, so he turned sideways and wrapped his soft sword around the opponent's blade accurately., with a slight turn of his wrist, he used his strength to strike, instantly removing the opponent's majestic strength.
The originally fierce and fierce sword force met Liu Yang's soft sword, and it was like a heavy punch hitting cotton wool. It had nowhere to exert its force and all failed. Many killers use old moves, all their strength is exhausted, and their bodies are unbalanced. Liu Yang's soft sword taps lightly, and the sword light flashes across the opponent's throat and wrists with precision. The moves are precise and cruel, defeating the enemy with one blow, and there is no unnecessary movement.
The two of them, one on the left and one on the right, fought side by side, working together in perfect harmony. They had already gone through countless life-and-death battles, and knew each other's offensive and defensive rhythms without the need for verbal communication.
Tie Xun was strong in the front and defended calmly. His thick iron sword blocked all frontal attacks and held his position firmly, intercepting all the opponent's fierce attacks. Liu Yang roamed the flanks and made agile surprise attacks. With his exquisite body skills and soft sword moves, he broke open the gaps and harvested the battle. One strong and one soft, one defensive and one offensive, one stable and one spiritual, two sword lights, one black and one white, intertwined on the rocky beach, both offensive and defensive, integrated.
Dozens of killers took turns to charge, and the attacks were continuous and layered, but they were still unable to break through the two people's joint defense line. Anyone who came close to him would either be blown away by Tie Xun's heavy sword and severely wounded, or his throat would be sealed by Liu Yang's soft sword to restrain the enemy. A corpse soon fell on the beach. Blood soaked the bluestone, flowed along the cracks in the stone, and merged into the shallow water on the beach, dyeing the cold river water dark red.
Li Kui stood outside the encirclement, watching with cold eyes, his face becoming increasingly gloomy and ugly. He originally thought that with dozens of elite dead soldiers surrounding them and dealing with just two people, they would be able to capture them in an instant without any effort. But at this moment, the battle situation reversed. His killers took turns charging, causing heavy casualties, but they were still unable to shake the two of them. They were even suppressed by the two of them and retreated steadily, and the offensive became increasingly weak.
"A bunch of trash!" Li Kui cursed angrily in a low voice, his eyes filled with anger. He was well aware of the combat power of his dead soldiers, all of whom were elites with one against ten, but today they were suppressed by two people, which showed that the combined fighting power of Tie Xun and Liu Yang was terrifying, far beyond the rumors.
If it drags on any longer, all of his dead soldiers will be lost here. By then, he will be the only one left to face the enemy, and the situation will be completely passive. Li Kui no longer waited and watched, and stepped on the ground suddenly. His figure suddenly jumped out, as fast as thunder, and with a fierce and murderous aura, he rushed straight into the center of the battle circle.
"Back off!" Li Kui shouted sternly.
Upon hearing this, the remaining killers immediately retreated, exited the battle circle, and stood far away from the outside, breathing heavily and not daring to rush forward again.
The battlefield was cleared instantly, and only Tie Xun, Liu Yang, and Li Kui were left confronting each other in the center of the rocky beach. The air instantly froze, and the chilling atmosphere reached its peak. The river wind roared, carrying the bloody smell, and the sound of waves crashing on the shore became clearer and clearer, but it made the confrontation at this moment even more silent and dangerous.
